title: Updating the twice-count register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $14$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its twice-count value by $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 14 equal to its twice-count field. Replacing coordinate 14 of
this vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing
its twice-count field by $y$.
